messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] shinyapps.io billing cycle question
parts:
My response from the other thread:

Sam,

Yes. Subscribing to a paid subscription for shinyapps.io will update your billing cycle to the current date.

Hope that helps.
-Andy

On Thu, Apr 30, 2015 at 12:04 PM, Samuel Jenness <sjen...@uw.edu> wrote:
Dear Rstudio,

The current "billing cycle" on my currently free level shinyapps account is on the 9th of each month. If I purchase a Basic account plan today, will that reset the billing cycle to the 30th of each month, or will it stay as the 9th? My concern is that if I'm paying for 250 hours of app time that would have to be used in only 10 days. Could you please clarify your billing policies?

Thank you,
Sam Jenness
